content:
The stochastic refill calculation task was successfully completed by implementing Z-score safety buffers, window-constrained inbound logic, and tanker capacity rounding.
Date handling required converting Excel inputs to datetime.date objects before applying timedelta arithmetic to prevent type errors. Output compliance was achieved by formatting dates as ISO strings (YYYY-MM-DD) while preserving native Python booleans. The Required_Refill_Date logic correctly branched based on scheduled refill arrival times, and Rounding_Applied was accurately triggered by non-zero remainders of Additional_Liters_Needed divided by Tanker_Capacity.
